tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi bstod bskul bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ nga ni sku gsum mnyam sbyor zhing*// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid dngos// khyab bdag srid dang zhi ba'i gtso// he ru ka dpal rgyal po yi// de yi thugs kar gnas pa'i hūm̐// gzung dang 'dzin pa las grol zhing*// gnyis med ye shes chen po'i dngos// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan pa// de las skyes pa'i khwa gdong ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul ba yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// shar gyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i 'ug gdong ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// byang gi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ grih+na gṛh+na hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i khyi gdong ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal ba'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// nub kyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dbang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ grih+nā pa ya grih+nā pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i phag gdong ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// lho yi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig

/oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dzā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ skyes gshin rje brtan ma ni// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// shar lho'i phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ skyes gshin rje pho nya ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// lho nub mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ grih+na grih+na hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ skyes gshin rje mche ba ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// nub byang mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ grih+nā pa ya grih+nā pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ skyes gshin rje 'joms ma ni// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// byang shar mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig

/oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān bi d+yā rā dzā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i dum skyes ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// steng gi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzad cig /oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i dum skyes ma// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// 'og gi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmongs shing gnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcing dang rengs pa yis// tshar bcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par// pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng*// ram̐ las byung ba'i nyi dkyil gyi// dbus su hūm̐ las byung ba yi// rgya chen sna tshogs rdo rje ni// shar sngo byang ljang nub dmar zhing*// lho ser lte ba mthing nag la// hūm̐ yig 'bar ba'i mtshan pa las// 'og tu 'od zer 'phros gyur pas// rgya dang rngams ni mtha' yas shing*// brtan zhing go skabs med pa yi// 'og phyogs rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur// oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha ba ban+dha hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐/ slar yang 'od zer phar 'phros pas// 'khor yug kun tu 'khor gyur cing*// kha khyer rdo rje'i phreng ba can// rdo rje'i rwa ba brtan pa dang*// rdo rje'i 'greng bur gyur pa yi// rdo rje'i drwa bas yongs su bskor// oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhun po lta bur rab brtan zhing*// khog pa yangs shing rab brjid pa'i// rgya chen rdo rje'i gur du gyur// oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/

hūm̐ las steng du 'od 'phros pas// nam mkha'i khams ni kun khyab cing*// bgegs la rdo rje'i char 'bebs pa'i// steng phyogs rdo rje'i bla rer gyur// oṃ badz+ra bi tā naṃ hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten thug pa'i bar// mde'u rtse bsnol rab 'bar ba yi// mda' yi drwa bas 'khrigs par gyur// oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ phyi rol kun du 'od 'phros pas// 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bur// 'ur 'ur chil chil sgra sgrogs shing*// me stag skar mda' lta bur 'phro// kha dog sna tshogs kun tu 'khrug /bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa// sa dang nam mkha' kun khyab pa'i// 'bar ba'i me dpung chen por gyur// oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal rgyal po yi// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// srung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis// rnal 'byor rtag tu srung bar byed// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// dpa' bo chen po rab bskul bas// thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi yi ge las// 'bar ba'i hūm̐ bcu rab 'phros nas// hūm̐ yig de dag gyur pa las// khams gsum 'joms pa'i nus pa can// bskal pa'i me ltar 'od 'phro ba'i// rdo rje phur bu rnam bcur gyur// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ slar yang hūm̐ las hūm̐ bcu 'phros// hūm̐ bcu yongs su gyur pa las// srid gsum 'jig byed nus pa can// rdo rje tho ba rnam bcur gyur// oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ phyogs bcur gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs// thams cad nga la mnyan par gyis// lha dang lha min grul bum sogs// zhi zhing zhi ba'i sems ldan pa// de dag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bkas// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// byang chub sems la gnas par gyis// gnod sbyin srul po gang ci'ang rung*// gdug cing dug pa'i sems ldan pa// de dag mngon spyod las kyis ni// da lta nyid du bsgral bar bya// hūm̐ phyogs bcur srung ba'i pho nya'i tshogs// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhom pa'i phyir// rdo rje phur bu 'di dag dang*// tho ba 'di dag blang bar gyis// de nas rdo rje pho nya bcus// phyag g.yon dang pos phur bu blangs// g.yas kyi dang pos tho ba bsnams// 'og g.yas cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// sprul pas nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// drag po'i las la brtson par gyur// hūm̐ shar phyogs srung ba'i khwa gdong ma// sprul pa du ma dang bcas pas// shar gyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// rig sngags zhags pas myur du chings// rdo rje'i lta bas rengs par gyis// hūm̐ gi sgra yis brgyal byas nas// 'bar ba'i rdo rje phur bu yis// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dgas par gyis// oṃ kā kā s+ye/

oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje tho ba yis// rdo rje phur bu rab bsnun nas// rdul phran tsam du rlag par gyis// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ byang phyogs srung ba'i 'ug gdong ma// sprul pa du ma dang bcas pas// byang gi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// rig sngags zhags pas myur du chings// rdo rje'i lta bas rengs par gyis// hūm̐ gi sgra yis brgyal byas nas// 'bar ba'i rdo rje phur bu yis// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dgas par gyis// oṃ u lū kā s+ye/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta/ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje tho ba yis// rdo rje phur bu rab bsnun nas// rdul phran tsam du rlag par gyis// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ nub phyogs srung ba'i khyi gdong ma// sprul pa du ma dang bcas pas// nub kyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// rig sngags zhags pas myur du chings// rdo rje'i lta bas rengs par gyis// hūm̐ gi sgra yis brgyal byas nas// 'bar ba'i rdo rje phur bu yis// spyi bo'i gtsug nas dgas par gyis// oṃ shwa nā s+ye/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta/ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje tho ba yis// rdo rje phur bu rab bsnun nas// rdul phran tsam du rlag par gyis// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/
